semantics.member_rule: Every exported member uses an exact identity/ref.
semantics.private_rule: Internal implementation detail is not part of public semantic contract unless exported.
semantics.dependency_rule: Dependencies are explicit and never inferred from import/file adjacency.
semantics.operation_rule: Exported operation definition does not imply authorization/execution.
semantics.closure_rule: A declared module surface can be recursively enumerated deterministically.

invariants.rule: Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.
